name: Agent-to-agent protocols
note: re-derived by `python -m foundry.completion --audit` on every CI run

refusals.card_not_signed_by_its_key: the card is not signed by the key it names
refusals.claim_while_suspended: claims suspended: result for t-factor-2 refuted (product and primality); an oper
refusals.forged_request_signature: request signature does not verify against the admitted key
refusals.foundry_op_over_the_wire: method not found: 'foundry/apply'; the embassy exposes ['embassy/challenge', 'em
refusals.interior_path: method not found: 'ledger/read'; the embassy exposes ['embassy/challenge', 'emba
refusals.replayed_nonce: nonce already used; a presentation is not replayable
refusals.replayed_sequence: sequence 1 is not after 1; replay refused
refusals.submit_twice: task t-factor is accepted; a result is submitted once
refusals.submit_unclaimed: task 't-sort' is not claimed by you
refusals.unknown_method_signed: method not found: 'tasks/delete'; the embassy exposes ['embassy/challenge', 'emb
refusals.unsigned_before_admission: unsigned request; every call after admission is signed by the agent's key
refusals.wrong_audience: presentation signature does not verify for this audience, card and nonce
